first.mjs.source: import fs from'node:fs';export default class{onTestRunEnd(){fs.appendFileSync('provider-trace.jsonl',JSON.stringify({name:'first-enter',jsonExists:fs.existsSync('cases.json')})+'\n');return new Promise(resolve=>{const file="<OUTPUT_DIR>/release";const check=()=>{if(fs.existsSync(file)){fs.unwatchFile(file,check);resolve()}};fs.watchFile(file,{interval:10},check);check()})}}
